enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Breathe. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Breathe slowly.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Rinse toothbrush. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea) and packing lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and lunch container. Take out plate and tea bag. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Take toast out of toaster. Put toast on plate. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Stand up. Pick up plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Place lunch container in bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and gathering work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up work bag. Zip bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community center
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Look at phone. Put phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Tap transit card. Walk down aisle. Sit in empty seat. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to community center. Open door. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the community center: coordinating program logistics, meeting partner organizations, and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email program. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone call. Talk on phone. Hang up. Walk to meeting room. Shake hands with partner. Sit in chair. Discuss program logistics. Take notes. Stand up. Walk back to desk. Open program files. Update logistics spreadsheet. Save file.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Stand in line. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Take receipt. Wait for order. Pick up sandwich. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Take bite. Chew. Swallow. Take another bite. Drink water. Finish sandwich. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away wrapper. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the community center: running afternoon program sessions, updating schedules and reports
enriched_activities.desc: Return to desk. Open computer. Open program files. Prepare materials. Walk to program room. Set up chairs. Greet participants. Start session. Speak to group. Hand out materials. Answer questions. End session. Clean up. Return to desk. Update schedule. Type report. Save file. Print report. File report. Turn off computer.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Look at phone. Put phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Tap transit card. Walk down aisle. Sit in empty seat. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to house. Open front door. Enter house. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, then loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Take out pot. Fill pot with water. Turn on stove. Chop vegetables. Put vegetables and meat in pot. Turn off stove. Pour into bowl. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up bowl. Open dishwasher. Place bowl in dishwasher. Add detergent. Press start. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Press power button. Point remote at TV. Press channel up button. Put remote on sofa. Lean back. Cross legs. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Press volume down. Put remote down. Stretch arms. Adjust cushion. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Press power button to turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower now that the evening water-heater peak has ended
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Open shower curtain. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review program materials and plan tomorrow's tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open email. Open program materials. Read. Scroll. Make notes. Open calendar. Plan tasks. Type. Save. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Light leisure time reading and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Look at TV. Pick up remote. Press channel up. Put remote down. Continue reading. Turn page. Look at TV. Pick up remote. Press power button to turn off TV. Put book down. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Breathe. Turn onto back. Stretch arms. Remain still. Breathe slowly.
